turn.user_message: Can we try it on one ward first?
turn.context: Prompt 1 of bm-pr-09. Transcript 31: step 3 is where the day changes, after read access and four weeks of measuring. The trial is that step on one ward; goals are set from the ward’s own first days.

transcript.label: After transcript turn 31 · Processes, turn 10 (the record stops at 31)

text: Yes. Two weeks on one ward, once read access is in and your four weeks of numbers are measured.
bullets: The first three days only record the day as it runs. Nothing changes for anyone.
Then dates are checked on the round, and after that the desk calls patients in by the plan.
On day 14 you read dead bed time and admission times, before and after.
chat.invite: Last, we can list what we need from you to start.
prompts: What do you need from us to start?
What if the trial goes badly?
chat.pointer: Play the two weeks, or pick a part of the trial.

blocks.title: Two weeks on one ward
blocks.deck: The trial as a strip of days. Play it to see each part start.

ward.label: The ward with most planned admissions
ward.note: Most planned patients means the change shows fastest. You pick the ward.
ward.ask: Which ward would you start on?

needs: No new staff for the trial

phases.title: Record the day as it runs
Patients called in by the plan

blocks.condition: Goals are set on day 3 from the ward’s own times. None are guessed now.

sheets.title: Record the day as it runs
sheets.text: Nothing changes yet. The ward records when each bed frees and when each patient reaches a bed.

lines.label: Recorded
lines.value: Bed free, patient in bed, bills

sheets.entry: What would get in the way on these days?

sheets.title: Dates checked on the round
sheets.text: Doctors check likely dates on the round. The 5 PM round starts. The plan is made but nobody is called in by it yet.
sheets.entry: Which doctor would start this best?

sheets.title: Patients called in by the plan
sheets.text: The desk calls planned patients in for their bed’s time. This is where the day changes.
sheets.entry: Who on the desk would run this?

sheets.title: Read the numbers
sheets.text: Dead bed time and admission times, before and after. Then you decide whether it spreads.
